mapper.select: SELECT a.agent_id AS owner_id, a.agent_code AS owner_code, a.agent_name AS owner_name, a.status AS owner_status, av.version_no, av.status AS version_status, tv.version_no AS referenced_version_no, (a.current_version_id = av.agent_version_id AND a.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool binding ON binding.tool_version_id = tv.tool_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version av ON av.agent_version_id = binding.agent_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.agent_id = av.agent_id WHERE tv.tool_id = #{toolId} ORDER BY active DESC, a.agent_code, av.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET tool_name = #{toolName}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool t SET status = #{status}, revision = t.revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE t.tool_id = #{toolId} AND t.revision = #{revision}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool binding ON binding.tool_version_id = tv.tool_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.current_version_id = binding.agent_version_id WHERE tv.tool_id = t.tool_id AND a.status = 'ENABLED' )
UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool SET status = status WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
